text: Appeal of Order to Comply (August 12, 2021) for 230 Oak Street, Underground Parking Garage

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply (August 12, 2021) for 230 Oak Street, Underground Parking Garage, Folder No. 21 195630 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so grant an extension of time to December 15, 2022.
